kultivator.pengaturan.titah_film.note: Cinematic camera Off, Reduce motion and Sky journey: Off always win over this choice.
kultivator.pengaturan.key.change: Change it with "Change keys…" in this group.
kultivator.pengaturan.rebind.tip: Opens Minecraft's Controls screen; every key of this mod is in the Kultivator category. Esc comes back here.
kultivator.pengaturan.quick_actions: The %1$s key is also Minecraft's "%2$s", which only works on servers that define a quick-actions dialog (there both run). Change one of them with "Change keys…".
kultivator.pengaturan.clash_note: Keys shown in orange are also used by another key; hover a row to see which.
